The Last Frequency

A listening station four hundred metres under the ice is receiving a signal that remembers what has not happened yet.
Headphones recommended. Sound carries most of what happens here.

Thirteen days under the ice. Progress is kept as you go. If something follows you, keep it in sight.
Psychological horror. Grief, isolation, alcohol and drug use.
Story and development by Sayan
